executions.name: Dawn, Once More
executions.script: Holds the loser by the collar, whispers 'look away', supernova at skin contact — flesh vaporizes in a rolling wave from the touch-point; the standing skeleton takes one step, collapses into the pool, and the pool boils.

executions.name: The Long Fall
executions.script: Rockets them into the black Rift-sky until both vanish. Three silent seconds. The loser returns alone as a meteor — the crater fills slowly from the bottom.

desecration.name: Last Light
desecration.script: A routine Sunlance burns through instead of knocking down; the opponent stands haloed for a beat, then drops as ash from the chest out.

overdrive.name: NOON
overdrive.script: One second of true daylight — a screen-wide column of vertical light hammers the opponent into the ground. In Court arenas the architecture visibly recoils.
